resources.string: Pick several contacts at once and add them to Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers\" list. They are added the next time that screen opens. Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers\" switch must be on for them to be recorded.
Waiting to be added: %d. Open Phone → Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers.
Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers → Add\" opens this module\'s multi-select list instead of the one-contact picker. Restart Google Phone after changing.
Contacts permission is needed to list your phone numbers.
%d number(s) ready. In Phone, open Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers to add them.
Couldn\'t open Google Phone. Open Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers in Phone to add them.
Numbers already on Google Phone\'s list are marked after you open Phone → Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers once.
